4. The Appellant, who has been convicted for commission of offence under Section 376(AB) of the IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act by the learned Ad hoc Addl. District and Sessions Judge (First Track Special Court under POCSO Act-01), Cuttack, in Special G.R.Case No.162/2021 arising out of Tangi P.S.Case No.239/2021 and sentenced to undergo R.I. for a period of twenty years along with fine, in judgment dated 30.8.2024, has prayed to release him on bail pending appeal.

It is submitted on behalf of the Appellant that the prosecution case is not supported by medical evidence.

6. Upon hearing the parties and taking note of the evidence of the victim (P.W.1), P.W.18 and other witnesses and age of the victim on the date of occurrence, I am not inclined to release the Appellant on bail at this stage.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail is rejected.
List the appeal in the last week of November 2025 for hearing.
